title: CDP Runtime Enable With Retry T3 Reference
desc: T3 ref. BeginAttachmentLock wrap history, pipe-break token integration.
steps: v7.5.8 fix (commit 0cf4bc8ae): BeginAttachmentLockAsync + CompleteAttachmentLockAsync wrap around EnableRuntimeWithRetry. Catches any exception (including timeout), gracefully releases lock, fresh socket state on next ConnectAsync.
PipeBreakToken AsyncLocal: EnableRuntimeWithRetry checks PipeBreakToken.Value before each delay. If Eye pipe dead -> cancel immediately, don't wait full backoff. Defined in CdpClient.InputGuard.cs.
BeginAttachmentLock graceful Complete added to mirror existing: CdpClient.Core.cs catch block adds try{await CompleteAttachmentLockAsync(...)}catch{} pattern (also v7.5.6, commit 62c3e17fe).
author: claude
